feature_graph.graph_summary: UNIFIED (Sheet 1 + Sheet 2): SCM Compact PRU Housing — 15CDV6, heat treated 31-38 HRC, cadmium plated 8-12 microns, weight 109 kg, revision 5. Sheet 1 provides the overall part envelope (671.1 × 443.9 mm, depth ≈309 mm) and primary views (VIEW-B, VIEW-C, VIEW-D, main upper-left, lower-left, sections A-A/D1-D1/T-T/S-S, details A1/E). Sheet 2 provides supplemental sections (F-F, G-G, G1/G2, J-J, K-K, L-L, N-N, P-P, Q-Q) and DETAIL-H hole patterns. Unified graph: 75 features (F001–F075), 173 relationships, 11 datum entries (A, B, C, D, D_S2, E, F, G, H, J, K). | SHEET 1 SUMMARY: The part is a complex one-piece 15CDV6 SCM compact PRU housing, cadmium plated 6-12 microns and heat treated to 31-38 HRC. Its visible envelope is approximately 671.1 mm long by 443.9 mm high with an estimated depth around 309 mm. Geometry consists of a large curved upper saddle/flange, broad symmetric front/back faces, central web, lower rounded mounting pads, inclined A1/D1 pad/lug regions, circular boss faces with central bores and M8 tapped bolt-circle patterns, multiple M5/M8 tapped holes, precision Ø15 H7 holes with Ø33 spotfaces, rounded rectangular pockets typical at five locations, internal sloped/diagonal channels and ribs, plus numerous R5/R8/R10/R20 and small R1.5/R5.6 blends. Datums A, B, C, D and K are identified, though A and K surface association is partly ambiguous in the raster. Several depth/PCD values are not fully legible and are flagged for clarification. | SHEET 2 SUMMARY: The part is a complex 15CDV6 steel SCM compact PRU housing, heat treated to 31-38 HRC and cadmium plated 8-12 microns. The visible sheet is primarily a second-sheet detail/section drawing: VIEW-U shows a complex central housing with upper/lower mounting plates, ribs and three right-hand cylindrical boss regions, while sections define arched cavities, rectangular and U-shaped channels, stepped coaxial bores, datum faces, repeated radii, and threaded/clearance/precision hole patterns. DETAIL-H defines the principal flange hole groups: 2 × Ø11H7 positioned to F-H-J, 3 × Ø11H7 positioned to D-E, 7 × Ø10.5 with Ø0.2 positional control, and an M5x0.8 tapped hole. SECTION N-N defines 2 × M5x0.8 tapped holes 11 mm deep perpendicular to the surface. Complete overall envelope dimensions are not available on this sheet.
